role: open-source HIDS: Sysmon/ETW detection with gene rules, enrichment and artifact dumps

payload.install: SCM registration (New-Service) — v1.7.0 ships NO -install verb
payload.config: config.toml (v1.7.0 default path, next to the binary)

requirements.sysmon: required — WHIDS depends on Sysmon for kernel telemetry (ProcessCreate/ProcessTerminate logging mandatory)

notes: Installed by Plasma from the release bundle (Apache-2.0; LICENSE travels with it). Plasma pulls alerts from Logs\Alerts and pushes IOC gene rules into Database\Rules\plasma-iocs.gen (gene schema 1.0.0 — the only schema v1.7.0's engine compiles). INHERENTLY DETECT-ONLY: the v1.7.0 engine has no response-action system at all (no kill/blacklist/block verbs exist at this tag); Plasma's whids.toml additionally documents a report-only [actions] block for forward-compatibility with later WHIDS lines.
